assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder with mood-congruent psychotic features
assertions.quote: The content of all delusions and hal- lucinations is consistent with the typical depressive themes

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder with mood-incongruent psychotic features
assertions.quote: The content of the delusions or hal- lucinations does not involve typical depressive themes

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder with catatonia
assertions.quote: The catatonia specifier can apply to an episode of depression if cata- tonic features are present during most of the episode

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder with peripartum onset
assertions.quote: onset of mood symptoms occurs during pregnancy or in the 4 weeks follow- ing delivery

assertions.subject: Major depressive episode

assertions.subject: Postpartum major depressive episode
